questions.title: Does the agent's open ticket have to be about a payout?
questions.question: A support agent has an open ticket for this merchant, but it is about a refund (not a payout problem). Should they see the full bank details, or only the last four digits of the account?

options.label: Any open ticket for the merchant unlocks full details
options.clarification: A support agent with an open ticket of any topic for the merchant sees the full account number, routing number and account holder name; the ticket does not need to be about a payout.

options.label: Only an open payout ticket unlocks full details
options.clarification: A support agent sees the full account number, routing number and account holder name only with an open payout-topic ticket for that merchant; with any other ticket topic they see only the last four digits of the account.
